events.content: Devices talk to the hub over Zigbee
The hub runs Raspberry Pi OS
Remote access goes through our AWS IoT Core backend
Automations must run locally on the hub without internet
The mobile app is built with Ionic
Use Matter over Thread as the primary device protocol, keeping Zigbee only for legacy devices
events.rationale: Matter is where new devices are going

events.content: The hub runs a custom Yocto Linux image with A/B updates
events.rationale: SD card corruption bricked hubs during updates

events.content: Remote access uses a WireGuard tunnel to the hub instead of AWS IoT Core
events.rationale: IoT Core cost per device and vendor lock-in

events.content: Rebuild the mobile app natively in Swift and Kotlin
events.rationale: Ionic could not do background Bluetooth pairing
